# Load actigraph data

```{r}

read_group <- function(dir){
  files <- list.files(dir, full.names = TRUE)
  lapply(files, function(f){
    d <- read.csv(f)
    d$subject <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
    d
  })
}
```

# data cleaning

```{r}

settings <- data.frame(epochlength = 60L)

clean_subject <- function(d){
  d <- setDT(d)
  d[, timestamp := as.POSIXct(timestamp, tz = "Europe/Oslo")] # study data from Oslo, needed because of time change to summer time in some recordings (causes issues)
  
  # required format for algorithms
  d[, `:=`(axis1 = activity, axis2 = 0, axis3 = 0)]
  
  d <- d[!is.na(timestamp)][!duplicated(timestamp)]

  # apply Choi for non-wear
  # set detected periods to missing to avoid including invalid data
  # high min length to avoid falsely removing sleep
  periods <- apply_choi(tbl_agd(d, settings), use_magnitude = FALSE, min_period_len = 540)
  if (nrow(periods) > 0){
    nonwear <- Reduce(`|`, Map(function(s, e) d$timestamp >= s & d$timestamp <= e,
                               periods$period_start, periods$period_end))
    d[nonwear, activity := NA]
  }

  # aggregate to 15-min bins
  d[, bin := floor_date(timestamp, "15 minutes")]
  b <- d[, .(activity = mean(activity, na.rm = TRUE)), by = bin]
  b[is.nan(activity), activity := NA]

  full <- data.table(bin = seq(min(b$bin), max(b$bin), by = "15 min"))
  b <- b[full, on = "bin"]
  b[, id := d$subject[1]][]
}

condition_bins <- lapply(condition_all, clean_subject)
control_bins <- lapply(control_all, clean_subject)

condition_data <- lapply(condition_bins, function(d) matrix(as.numeric(d$activity), ncol = 1))
control_data <- lapply(control_bins, function(d) matrix(as.numeric(d$activity), ncol = 1))
```

# Leave-one-out classification

```{r}

library(parallel)

# same as before, for zero inflated Gamma emissions
emis_zigamma <- function(fit, X){   # T x J emission matrix (per state aggregate)
  T_len <- nrow(X)
  J <- ncol(fit$mu)
  ap <- matrix(1, T_len, J)
  
  for (j in seq_len(J)){
    pj <- rep(1, T_len)
    
    for (k in seq_len(ncol(X))){
      x <- X[, k]
      sh <- (fit$mu[k, j] / fit$sigma[k, j])^2
      sc <- fit$sigma[k, j]^2 / fit$mu[k, j]
      dk <- rep(1, T_len) # for NA
      
      is0 <- !is.na(x) & x == 0
      pos <- !is.na(x) & x != 0
      
      # account for zero counts
      dk[is0] <- fit$z[k, j]
      dk[pos] <- (1 - fit$z[k, j]) * dgamma(x[pos], shape = sh, scale = sc)
      pj <- pj * dk
    }
    ap[, j] <- pj
  }
  ap
}

loglik_hmm  <- function(fit, X)
  -my_forward_hsmm(fit$delta, fit$tpm, emis_zigamma(fit, X), nrow(X))

loglik_hsmm <- function(fit, X, R_vec){ # recycle each aggregate across its sub-states
  ap <- emis_zigamma(fit, X)[, rep(seq_len(ncol(fit$mu)), times = R_vec), drop = FALSE]
  -my_forward_hsmm(fit$delta, fit$tpm_hmm, ap, nrow(X))
}


# Leave-one out cross validation

# leave one subject out, fit models on remaining subjects
# one per group with depressive disorders, one for controls
# assign held-out subject to group whose fitted model gave higher likelihood
# repeat until all subjects are held out once

# gc and pre_schedule FALSE because creating AD tape is expensive!
# if run interrupted, resumes only for the ones still missing

loso_classify <- function(fit_two, score, ncores = 5, tag = "loso"){
  
  nD <- length(condition_data)
  nC <- length(control_data)
  all_data <- c(condition_data, control_data)
  all_grp <- c(rep("Depression", nD), rep("Control", nC))
  
  all_id <- tryCatch(
    c(vapply(condition_bins, function(d) d$id[1], ""),
      vapply(control_bins, function(d) d$id[1], "")),
    error = function(e) sprintf("subj_%03d", seq_len(nD + nC)))
  N <- nD + nC

  resdir <- tag
  logfile <- paste0(tag, ".log")
  
  dir.create(resdir, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  cat(sprintf("LOSO start %s | N=%d | cores=%d | dir=%s\n",
              format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), N, ncores, resdir),
      file = logfile, append = TRUE)

  one <- function(i){
    truth <- all_grp[i]
    resfile <- file.path(resdir, paste0(all_id[i], ".rds"))

    # skip existing subjects (ensures progress is saved if run interrupted)
    if (file.exists(resfile)){                    
      cat(sprintf("[%s] %2d/%d  %-14s skip (done)\n",
                  format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), i, N, all_id[i]),
          file = logfile, append = TRUE)
      return(readRDS(resfile)$pred)
    }

    dep <- condition_data
    con <- control_data
    if (i <= nD){
      dep <- condition_data[-i]
      } else {
        con <- control_data[-(i - nD)]}

    pred <- tryCatch({
      fits <- fit_two(dep, con)
      p <- if (score(fits$dep, all_data[[i]]) > score(fits$con, all_data[[i]]))
             "Depression" else "Control"
      rm(fits)
      gc()  # memory                            
      p
    }, error = function(e){ 
      gc()
      NA_character_ })

    if (!is.na(pred)){          
      tmp <- paste0(resfile, ".tmp")
      saveRDS(data.frame(id = all_id[i], true = truth, pred = pred,
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE), tmp)
      file.rename(tmp, resfile)         
    }

    line <- sprintf("[%s] %2d/%d  %-14s true=%-10s pred=%-10s %s\n",
                    format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), i, N, all_id[i], truth,
                    ifelse(is.na(pred), "NA", pred),
                    if (is.na(pred)) "(failed)" else if (pred == truth) "OK" else "x")
    cat(line)             
    cat(line, file = logfile, append = TRUE)    
    pred}

  # parallelize
  res <- mclapply(seq_len(N), one, mc.cores = ncores, mc.preschedule = FALSE)
  pred <- vapply(res, function(x) if (is.character(x) && length(x) == 1L) x else NA_character_, "")
  ok <- !is.na(pred)

  cat(sprintf("LOSO done  %s | acc=%.3f | failed=%d\n",
              format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"),
              mean(pred[ok] == all_grp[ok]), sum(!ok)),
      file = logfile, append = TRUE)

  list(accuracy = mean(pred[ok] == all_grp[ok]),
       n_failed = sum(!ok),
       table = table(true = all_grp[ok], pred = pred[ok]),
       pred = pred, resdir = resdir, logfile = logfile)
}

collect_loso <- function(tag){
  f <- list.files(tag, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  d <- do.call(rbind, lapply(f, readRDS))
  list(accuracy = mean(d$pred == d$true),
       table = table(true = d$true, pred = d$pred), data = d)}


# HMM

res_hmm <- loso_classify(
  function(dep, con) list(
    # fit HMMs (one per group)
    dep = mle_hmm_multiple(mu0, sigma0, z0, tpm0, J, dep),
    con = mle_hmm_multiple(mu0, sigma0, z0, tpm0, J, con)),
  function(fit, X) loglik_hmm(fit, X),
  ncores = 5, tag = "loso_hmm")

# nb-HSMM

R_vec <- c(40, 80)
nb_size0 <- c(2, 2)
nb_mu0 <- c(10, 10)
cond_tpm0 <- matrix(c(0, 1, 1, 0), 2, 2, byrow = TRUE)

res_nb <- loso_classify(
  function(dep, con) list(
    # one nb-HSMM per group
    dep = mle_nbhsmm_multiple(mu0, sigma0, z0, nb_size0, nb_mu0, cond_tpm0, J, dep, R_vec),
    con = mle_nbhsmm_multiple(mu0, sigma0, z0, nb_size0, nb_mu0, cond_tpm0, J, con, R_vec)),
  function(fit, X) loglik_hsmm(fit, X, R_vec),
  ncores = 5, tag = "loso_nbhsmm")

# qREML-HSMM

# penalize second-order differences, same as simulation
m <- 2
S <- lapply(R_vec, function(Ri) crossprod(makeD(Ri, m)))

p_list <- lapply(seq_len(J), function(i){ p <- dgeom(0:R_vec[i], prob = 0.1)
p / sum(p) })

par <- natural_to_unc_nonp_hsmm(mu0, sigma0, z0, p_list, cond_tpm0, J)

fit_qreml <- function(data_list){
  dat <- list(data_list = data_list, J = J, R_vec = R_vec, S = S, lambda = rep(1e2, J))
  f <- qreml_capped(pen_nll, par, dat, random = paste0("unc_p", seq_len(J)))
  p <- extract_relevant_pars(f, "nonp", R_vec, J)
  list(mu = p$mu, sigma = p$sigma, z = p$z, delta = p$delta, tpm_hmm = p$hmm_tpm)
}

res_qreml <- loso_classify(
  function(dep, con) list(dep = fit_qreml(dep), con = fit_qreml(con)),
  function(fit, X) loglik_hsmm(fit, X, R_vec),
  ncores = 5, tag = "loso_qreml")

# Results

sapply(list(HMM = res_hmm, nbHSMM = res_nb, qREML = res_qreml),
       function(r) c(accuracy = r$accuracy, failed = r$n_failed))


```


# create results table

```{r}

metrics <- function(tag){
  d <- collect_loso(tag)$data
  cm <- table(true = factor(d$true, c("Control","Depression")),
              pred = factor(d$pred, c("Control","Depression")))
  
  TP <- cm["Depression","Depression"]
  FN <- cm["Depression","Control"]
  
  FP <- cm["Control","Depression"]
  TN <- cm["Control","Control"]
  
  sens <- TP/(TP+FN)
  prec <- TP/(TP+FP)
  c(Accuracy = (TP+TN)/sum(cm), Sensitivity = sens,
    Specificity = TN/(TN+FP), F1 = 2*prec*sens/(prec+sens))
}

metric_tab <- t(sapply(
  c(HMM = "loso_hmm", `nb-HSMM` = "loso_nbhsmm", qREML = "loso_qreml"),
  metrics))
round(metric_tab, 3)

print(xtable(metric_tab, digits = 3, align = "lcccc",
             caption = "Leave-one-out classification performance.",
             label = "tab:loso"),
      booktabs = TRUE, caption.placement = "top")


```
